hidden_views.reason: The charged shell that falls and turns and the balanced shell at rest are two spacetimes of one page: the isotropic chart's drawings mark the moment of the shell at rest, and every other drawing the moments of the falling shell.

hidden_surfaces.reason: The charged shell is inside r_- only from v - r = -0.25 r_s on, so the first two moments have no part in the static chart inside r_- nor in the outgoing chart, which shares only that region with the ingoing one.
